title: Rubico亚洲固收主管：美联储按兵不动，高油价或已开始破坏需求
speaker: Two Hot

segments.en: Let's bring in Two Hot, portfolio manager and Asia head of fixed income at Rubico. Two Hot, very nice to see you. Can we start with your assumptions in the macro?
segments.zh: 有请Rubico投资组合经理兼亚洲固收主管Two Hot。Two Hot，很高兴见到你。我们先从宏观假设开始好吗？

segments.en: What do you think the next move from the Fed is going to be? Is it going to be a hike or a cut?
segments.zh: 你认为美联储下一步会怎么做？加息还是降息？

segments.en: No, we think they're going to keep it on hold. The reason is that the CPI number yesterday gives the FOMC enough reason to hold for now. I think a hike is a bit too early to be expected.
segments.zh: 不，我们认为他们会按兵不动。原因是昨天的CPI数据给了美联储足够的理由暂时观望。我认为现在预期加息还为时过早。

segments.en: Given the fact that the labor market has been holding up well, but one of the things we may be reading into the more cautious core numbers could be that because headlines is so high, consumers are actually being priced out of other stuff.
segments.zh: 尽管劳动力市场表现良好，但我们从更谨慎的核心数据中解读出的信息是，由于整体通胀高企，消费者实际上被挤出其他消费。

segments.en: Therefore the demand isn't so strong in non-discretionary items. So we're going to watch that carefully as this is the first signs of demand destruction from the very strong higher energy prices.
segments.zh: 因此非必需品的需求并不强劲。我们将密切关注，因为这可能是高能源价格导致需求破坏的首个迹象。
